solutions.title: Recursive memoization
solutions.strategy: Memoize `(i, j)` choices for source suffix and target suffix.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each source/target suffix pair is solved once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Memo entries dominate recursion stack storage.

solutions.title: One-dimensional DP
solutions.strategy: Scan source characters and update target-prefix counts from right to left.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each source character updates each target position.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP array stores counts for target prefixes.
